chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Allah made this sacrifice so that your needy may be filled with meat, so feed them."

key_terms.فَأَطْعِمُوهُمْ: so give them food; feed them from it

ai.seo_question: Why did Allah legislate the sacrifice of al-Aḍḥā according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains a social wisdom behind the sacrifice of al-Aḍḥā: that the needy should benefit and be satisfied with meat. It emphasizes feeding the poor as an essential purpose connected to this act of worship.
